recommendation: Keep the commit. If the work group wants member-active to include period-based membership testing in addition to inactive status, handle that as a separate explicit tracker because FHIR-29701's approved scope was inactive=false or omitted.
issue_request: FHIR-29701 is a Published/Persuasive FHIR-I change request asking to add a Group member-active search parameter that works like member but only includes Groups where the specified member has inactive=false or inactive is omitted.
initial_application: No FHIR-29701 or member-active implementation commit was found. The current source had Group-member and later active-membership narrative, but source/group/bundle-Group-search-params.xml did not define member-active.
additional_context: Group is active in source/fhir.ini. FHIR-I 2020-12-07 minutes corroborate the Jira resolution. Later FHIR-37846 added Group membership guidance for _in and active member interpretation but did not add or supersede the requested member-active search parameter.
reconciliation: Added Group-member-active with code member-active, reference type, path Group.member.entity, and expression Group.member.where(inactive.empty() or inactive = false).entity. No narrative was changed because existing Group membership prose already provides active-member context.
source_changes: source/group/bundle-Group-search-params.xml: added Group-member-active SearchParameter next to Group-member.

related_jiras.note: Later Published issue added Group membership guidance for _in and active member interpretation; it is background and does not replace the FHIR-29701 search parameter request.
